title: Zero Percent Moon, Full Volume Stars
skyStory: Zero percent moon. Not a sliver, not a whisper. The moon is lying flat on its back in Capricorn, staring at the ceiling, planning the whole year in silence. Saturn has brought it a clipboard. The stars, finally free of competition, are showing off like a choir with no conductor. Somewhere off the coast, the sea is flat as slate and listening.

reading: You will have a brilliant idea before 10 am today and immediately want to tell five people. Tell one. Only one. The dark moon likes ideas that get to grow in private before they meet the world. The [[Knight of Wands]] is pacing, but trust me, he loves a slow reveal.

Around midday you might feel like you are not doing enough. That is a fib told by the [[Eight of Swords]], which builds cages out of to-do lists. Look at your hands. They built things last year. They will build things this year. Today they are allowed to just hold a warm drink.
joel.mission: Keep one exciting idea completely secret all day, telling no one, not even a notebook.
joel.omen: A kettle that dawdles forever and then sings all at once. The slow thing you are waiting on is nearly ready.
joel.stoneWhy: many small lights in the dark

reading: Second night of the dark moon in your sign, and the shore is so still you can hear ice ticking against the rocks. Today the universe hands you the gift of a quiet hour. Nobody will need you for exactly sixty minutes. Notice when it starts. Use it however you want.

[[The High Priestess]] sits at the edge of the water with a finger on her lips. Your intuition, the Life Path 11 kind, is so clear today it is almost loud. If a name pops into your head around 3 pm, send that person a message. They need it, and they will tell you why.
nancy.mission: When a name pops into your head for no reason today, message that person within five minutes.
nancy.omen: Ice ticking or creaking somewhere nearby. It means a stuck situation is starting, very quietly, to move.

together.text: Trade one quiet wish for the year, spoken out loud, big or small. The listener may not give advice or fix anything. The only allowed reply is: noted, and I am rooting for it. Saturn calls this the slowest high five in history.
